name: contract-lossless-json
goal: Retain every API JSON field and authored example value while preserving admitted input behavior

evidence: The comparator introduced in Codex commit 7ed8d6bc23 compares z.json rewritten output. The installed parser deliberately strips __proto__ keys, so changing a valid wire field can return success. The same schema is used for authored Examples; their parsed fields can disappear too. No third-party regression is claimed.

The existing json/initialized case covered ordinary fields and normalization, but trusted parser output as complete. Strengthen that case for reserved-field changes and current getter, array iterator/species, prototype and invalid-value admission. Strengthen registerExamples/initialized for authored-data round trips and existing schema-export APIs. Add the parser-review rule to the same generated-guidance cases. No test declarations added.

At fa02ed33dd the unchanged 12 existing cases fail: the API JSON comparison accepts changed reserved fields; authored Examples lose those fields; generated policy lacks the parser-review rule. The named comparator assertion is retained in immutable Harness evidence.

Use an internal JSON schema whose record parser safely defines every own string field while retaining Zod schema export, parse context, cycle memoization, getter order and array admission. Share it between authored Examples and API expectations. Keep the same four method cases and eight generated-guidance cases; add the parser-review checkpoint to shared and repository instructions.

The internal testJsonSchema defines lossless record fields safely before deferred Zod memoization, preserving schema export and parse context. API comparison and authored Examples share it. The existing 12 comparator, Examples and generated-guidance cases pass; compiler and lint pass, audit reports zero findings, registry zero errors.

Paired immutable snapshots at fa02ed33dd and 1b172612e9 ran the same 12 cases under one 1CPU/768MiB lease and unchanged command. Reserved JSON field comparisons and authored Examples fail at the broken revision and pass at the fix; generated parser-review guidance passes.
